# Module 3

**Transformers, Embeddings, and Hugging Face**

This module introduces transformers and embeddings, then applies them in a
hands-on Hugging Face session.

**Theme:** [Introduction to Machine Learning](https://hub.bioinformatics.ca/en-ca/workshops/cbw/2026-large-language-models-for-bioinformatics-edmonton-ab-2026); [Introduction to Large Language Models (LLMs)](https://hub.bioinformatics.ca/en-ca/workshops/cbw/2026-large-language-models-for-bioinformatics-edmonton-ab-2026).
